[RHIM.2.1] The compiler must check that every hydration target declares `corr`
as a non-nullable `String`, marked `key` on a `logical` schema, and that no
schema is both a hydration target and a response schema ([LHYD.4.1.7]). It must add no slot to any schema: the slot an
integrator, either runtime and every binding sees is the one the author
declared.
